name: state-check
on:
  push:
    branches: ["ai/20261030-routing-goal"]
    paths:
      - "tasks/status/**"
      - "results/**"
permissions:
  contents: write
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Validate states and rebuild index
        run: python3 .github/scripts/state_check.py
      - name: Commit index if changed
        run: |
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain tasks/status/INDEX.md)" ]; then
            git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
            git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
            git add tasks/status/INDEX.md
            git commit -m "状態一覧を自動更新（state-check）"
            git push
          fi
